description: Single-thread search before and after perf/single-thread-search on writerslogic-02, paired and interleaved on one pinned CPU (taskset -c 6): per dataset, rounds of [before 4-bit, after 4-bit, after 8-bit] with 2,000 test queries per configuration, two rounds, median QPS. These rounds ran outside the host timing lock (another job held it for the whole window) on a shared host at 1-minute load 9-25, so absolute QPS are below the v1 harness numbers and the before/after ratios are inflated where the before code waits on memory; a run of the same arms with 10,000 queries and three rounds under the lock is queued and will replace this file. before_4bit is the v1 standing configuration (4-bit traversal codes); after_4bit runs the new code on the same index and returns the same ids for every configuration (after_4bit_results_identical_to_before); after_8bit is the harness wrapper default from this change. Degree 32 on every set (the v1 GloVe 0.95 and 0.99 points used degree 64, which these rounds did not build).

hms.build: cargo build --release --features experimental (rustc 1.99.1); degree 32, build_ef 500, quantized_search, residual 8-bit, aligned rows, breadth-first order, 3-byte ids; search-profile driver (not committed) over VGraph::searcher().search

host.name: writerslogic-02
host.cpu: Intel Core Ultra 9 185H (WSL2, AVX2, no AVX-512)

profile_before.method: search-profile internal timers (query encoding, entry descent, adjacency+visited+prefetch issue, row estimates+pool, re-rank+sort) summed over 2,000 test queries, one thread, not pinned, host shared with other jobs; timers perturb the totals, the shares are the evidence
